sloka: तस्मिन् सम्पीड्यमाने तु भग्नद्रुमाशिलातले।न शेकुर्वानराः स्थातुं घूर्णमाने नगोत्तमे ।। ६.७४.३९ ।।
transliteration: tasmin sampīḍyamāne tu bhagnadrumāśilātale।na śekurvānarāḥ sthātuṁ ghūrṇamāne nagottame ।। 6.74.39 ।।

translations.english: As the foremost of the mountain got oppressed it crushed the trees and rocks on it and Vanaras were unable to stand on it.
